summary: Design contract workflows, approval routing, risk scores, and obligation tracking. Explore practical contract lifecycle management training.
lede: Contract lifecycle management training helps contract, procurement, legal, vendor, and project teams control workflows through renewal. It covers contract inventories, approval routing, risk and obligation registers, supplier review checkpoints, and renewal oversight through practical workflow maps, approval matrices, and dashboards; the focus is operational governance, not legal interpretation or drafting advice.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who administer, govern, or rely on contracts across procurement, legal, supplier management, and project delivery. It suits you if you need to improve contract workflow controls and operational follow-through. This course is designed for: Contract Managers coordinating drafting, approvals, obligations, and renewal dates. Procurement Officers aligning contract terms with sourcing decisions and purchase workflows. Legal Operations Specialists managing clause libraries, review queues, and contract records. Vendor Managers monitoring supplier commitments, service levels, and remediation actions. Project Managers tracking contractual deliverables, change requests, and acceptance evidence. Contract Administrators maintaining executed agreements, metadata, and obligation registers. Commercial Managers assessing contract exposure and negotiating operationally workable terms. Procurement Category Managers linking supplier agreements to category plans and performance reviews. Contract Risk Analysts maintaining risk scores, escalation triggers, and mitigation actions. Legal Counsel supporting contract governance, approval controls, and cross-functional handoffs.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working exposure to contracts, procurement, supplier management, legal operations, or project delivery is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel access for spreadsheet-based exercises; Power BI access is useful but not essential. AI-assisted clause classification and system integration are introduced at overview level. The course focuses on operational workflow design and does not provide legal advice or technical implementation training for a specific CLM platform.
